entryPointReview: Exact C helper and three selected production caller bodies traced against the pinned C source and the qualified natural A51 result. This delivery proves only the bounded JS source-parity correction through focused source tests; no C gameplay, public C parity, discovery, or certification is claimed.

functions.name: see_wsegs
functions.sourceReview: Traced complete C worm.c see_wsegs (487-495): iterate live tail list in order, stop before hidden head tracker, call newsym synchronously for each coordinate. No RNG, list mutation, occupancy filter, or Promise boundary. The JS implementation reads the selected state worm list and repaints only tail coordinates; clone mode uses explicit caller callbacks or retains named unresolved display.c newsym.
